units.source_text: 因为要将没法办的事来怎么办，便再没有工夫来拣手段了。

en.t: Because he had to find some way to deal with what could not be helped, he no longer had time to choose his means.

units.source_text: 一拣，便只是饿死在空地里或道旁；

en.t: If he chose, he would only starve to death in an empty lot or by the roadside;

units.source_text: 而且便只是搬到这门里来，弃掉了像一只狗。

en.t: and then he would merely be carried into this gate and thrown away like a dog.

units.source_text: 但不拣，则——家将的思想，在同一的路线上徘徊了许多回，才终于到了这处所。

en.t: But if he did not choose, then... The servant's thoughts wandered along the same path many times before finally arriving at this point.

units.source_text: 然而这一个“则”，虽然经过了许多时，结局总还是一个“则”。

en.t: Yet even after much time had passed, this one then still ended as nothing more than a then.

units.source_text: 家将一面固然肯定了不拣手段这一节了，

en.t: On the one hand, the servant had certainly accepted the point that he would not choose his means,

units.source_text: 但对于因为要这“则”有着落，自然而然的接上来的“只能做强盗”这一节，

en.t: but as for the conclusion that naturally followed in order to give that then a place to settle, that he could only become a robber,

units.source_text: 却还没有足以积极的肯定的勇气。

en.t: he still did not have enough courage to affirm it outright.
